title: Feed Scout finishes with a report when ticket gates fail
query: A bounded Feed Scout run finds five new articles, but two duplicate active tickets and the others lack executable scope or proof. ticket_limit is two. What happens?
reference_points: Normalizes, canonical-key dedupes, extracts, and evaluates the configured sources
Writes the dated Feed Scout report with Core report frontmatter before ticket projection
Records duplicate, scope-missing, and proof-missing candidates in the report
Creates no tickets merely to fill the cap
Does not invoke Interval, Goal, Pulse, workers, implementation, publication, or outreach

title: Feed Scout creates a bounded source-backed opportunity ticket
query: After writing its report, Feed Scout has one high-signal source delta with canonical evidence, no active duplicate, executable scope, expected Reward, proof, stop condition, and local write authority. ticket_limit is one. What may it do?
reference_points: Writes at most one local ticket after the dated report exists
Links the source evidence, ticket path, and admission decision back into the report
Defaults the ticket to review-required unless explicit write policy grants automatic local admission and no human or external gate remains
Does not start Goal, Pulse, a worker, implementation, spend, publication, or outreach
Returns the report path before ticket paths and a no-execution receipt

title: Feed Scout routes book-summary sources into skill workflow extraction
query: Run a dry pass over configured book-summary sources. Several new items contain exercises and reusable workflows. What happens before any ticket projection?
reference_points: Keeps the run explicit and bounded with no daemon, unapproved spend, or external write
Normalizes and dedupes items before extraction
Uses summarize and extracts triggers, inputs, steps, decisions, exercises, outputs, and proof ideas rather than generic recaps
Routes reusable skill behavior to skill-creator, broader techniques to harness-scout, converged patterns to best-of-worlds, and weak recaps to ledger-only status
Writes the dated report before applying source, dedupe, proof, authority, ticket-quality, and cap gates
